migration_units.target_condition: package.json declares version 6.0.0, updates toolchain devDependencies, declares an engines.node lower bound of Node.js 22.17 or newer, and no longer depends on devalue 4.3.3.
The lockfile resolves the package at version 6.0.0 with no residual 4.3.3 resolution.

The public package entry exports uneval, parse, unflatten, stringify, stringifyAsync, defaultStringifyOperations, defaultParseOperations, DevalueError, and filterArrayIndices with unchanged names; the internal entry file layout is not constrained.

The public package API exposes stringify and stringifyAsync with unchanged flattened payload semantics, including cyclic, repeated, and special-value handling, synchronous rejection, and rejection handling that leaves no reached thenable unhandled; private module layout is not constrained.

The public package API exposes parse and unflatten with revival equivalence, reference identity, rejection of malformed, out-of-range, invalid-circular, and __proto__ payloads, and rejection of view backing stores replaced by a reviver with anything other than an ArrayBuffer or SharedArrayBuffer; private module layout is not constrained.

The public uneval API returns equivalent executable JavaScript source, including IIFE wrapping for cyclic values, single emission of repeated long strings and BigInts with every position referenced, boxed-wrapper identity, and exact array length and hole reproduction when the prototype chain supplies an index; helper modules and their names are implementation details.

The migrated public entry exports frozen defaultStringifyOperations and defaultParseOperations that are overridable through options.operations; declaration syntax and private module layout are not constrained.

The public entry exports DevalueError with observable name, path, value, and root semantics and filterArrayIndices with payload-validation behavior; private helper implementation details are not constrained.
The package continues to declare its public TypeScript types with unchanged importable signatures; the private declaration file layout is not constrained.
The migrated public serialization API round-trips all documented binary value types; private codec module layout is not constrained.
All instruction-defined public APIs and observable behaviors remain available; the internal source module set is not constrained.

The candidate test layout is executable from the declared package scripts and retains serialization and deserialization regression coverage; no reference-only test file or runner configuration is required.

Regression coverage verifies stringify payload shape, special-value round-trips, sparse arrays, synchronous rejection, invalid-payload rejection, and sync/async agreement; test file layout is not constrained.
Regression coverage verifies that the default operation maps remain frozen, exported, and overridable; test file layout is not constrained.
Regression coverage verifies parse/unflatten equivalence and rejection of malformed payloads; test file layout is not constrained.
Regression coverage verifies binary value encoding used by special-value round-trips; test file layout is not constrained.
Regression coverage verifies DevalueError fields, filterArrayIndices, and payload rejection helpers; test file layout is not constrained.
tsconfig.json remains compatible with the migrated package's public type surface.
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the migrated package's test and type-check workflows.
README.md and CHANGELOG.md remain present; no release-note content is required.

The public uneval API accepts the 6.0.0 (value, js) replacer, renders tagged-template fragments recursively with shared identity, rejects non-fragment results with TypeError, and reserves identifiers written in template strings; helper module layout is not constrained.

stringify, stringifyAsync and uneval produce well-formed UTF-8 transportable output for unpaired UTF-16 surrogates at every nesting level and key position, while well-formed pairs keep their characters; private module layout is not constrained.

The package ships TypeScript declarations through its declared type entry that export JavaScriptFragment, JavaScriptTag and UnevalReplacer with the 6.0.0 shapes; the private declaration layout and generating tool remain unconstrained.
